value.rationale: The published theorem asserts an exact dual system for arbitrary uniformly bounded invertible local changes; its reconstruction can fail on every nonorthogonal normalized Riesz basis and returns a known-but-wrong operator, with exact Gram-matrix error. The repaired theorem preserves the intended coefficients and transformation generality, replaces only the geometrically incorrect image subspaces, proves genuine frame bounds, and restores both exact synthesis identities. This is a substantive reconstruction-validity boundary and a reproducible general repair, beyond an isolated numerical counterexample.
